description: This file is a PHP source file for a web-based firewall settings configuration page. It includes PHP code for retrieving current settings, JavaScript for UI interactions, and HTML structure for rendering the firewall configuration options, specifically for IPv4 firewall level settings and associated controls.

methods.name: keyboard_toggle
methods.description: Handles toggle behavior for security level description display when the corresponding radio button is selected.

methods.name: setFirewall
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to update firewall configuration on the backend with provided configuration data.
